about.title: Who I am
about.subtitle: About me
about.text1: Hi, I’m a Fullstack Developer passionate about building intuitive, high-performance, and scalable web applications. My journey into development started with a curiosity about how technology can simplify and improve everyday life.
about.text2: I love the problem-solving aspect of programming, where logic meets creativity. Turning complex technical challenges into elegant solutions is what drives me.
about.text3: I thrive in collaborative environments, where I can share knowledge, learn from others, and contribute to meaningful projects. Being adaptable, I work effectively both on-site and remotely.
about.text4: For me, programming isn’t just about writing code—it’s about creating impactful digital experiences that enhance businesses and people's lives. I am constantly learning and exploring new possibilities in tech.
